sources.name: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
sources.permitted_use: MIT-covered non-media metadata only: names, taxonomy (category/force/mechanic), equipment, target/secondary muscles, level, and schema/import ideas. Used only as discovery material for the project-authored catalog; every approved entry is independently reviewed.
sources.explicit_exclusion: Exclude upstream instruction and translation text from the initial catalog, plus all images/, videos/, GIFs, thumbnails, image, gif_url, media_id and media attribution payloads. The upstream exercise media is licensed from Gym visual (gymvisual.com) and is NOT licensed for reuse here.
sources.media_exclusion: images/, videos/, GIFs, thumbnails, image, gif_url, media_id, media_attribution. Gym visual media (c) gymvisual.com is excluded; cloning the upstream repo does not grant any media license.

sources.name: Snouzy/workout-cool
sources.permitted_use: Read-only structural comparison of the Prisma exercise, program, program-week, session, set, enrollment and progress relationships. Used only to contrast plan/execution separation concepts.
sources.explicit_exclusion: Do not copy code or data. Do not inherit its absent risk tier, missing-data gate, contraindications, stop conditions, provenance, policy version, or validator.
sources.media_exclusion: Not applicable: no content is imported from this comparison project.

sources.name: ACE Fitness official exercise references
sources.permitted_use: Item-level official ACE exercise pages or technical articles used to review healthy-adult setup, target area, equipment, and general form cues.
sources.explicit_exclusion: Not a clinical contraindication, diagnosis, rehabilitation, disease-specific, pregnancy, underage, post-operative, or red-flag programming source.
sources.media_exclusion: No ACE text or media copied; each exercise record was independently authored and records its specific review URL.

sources.name: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour
sources.permitted_use: General adult physical-activity context and the major-muscle strengthening baseline used to frame the healthy-adult policy envelope.
sources.explicit_exclusion: Not a per-exercise contraindication source and not a rehabilitation protocol.
sources.media_exclusion: No media copied; concepts cited, not reproduced.

sources.name: ACSM Position Stand 2026: Resistance Training Prescription (Healthy Adults)
sources.pinned_version: 2026 official position stand; ACSM summary published 2026-03-17
sources.permitted_use: Healthy-adult resistance-training policy envelope; supports bodyweight, elastic-band, and home training and simple conservative programming over advanced methods.
sources.explicit_exclusion: Does not authorize disease-specific, post-operative, pregnancy, underage, injury, or red-flag programming.
sources.media_exclusion: No media copied; cited concepts only.

sources.name: PAR-Q+ / ePARmed-X+
sources.permitted_use: Design reference for pre-participation clarification and restriction concepts only.
sources.explicit_exclusion: Do not copy questionnaire text, claim PAR-Q+ certification, or treat the project's narrower profile as equivalent clearance.
sources.media_exclusion: No media copied; conceptual reference only.

sources.name: Health project Phase 3 training catalog (project-authored)
sources.permitted_use: Project-authored curated exercise catalog content for personal-development validation only; the repository currently declares no distribution license.
sources.explicit_exclusion: Not a clinical endorsement, professional certification, or public-release approval. Personal-development review scope only; public release requires a separate qualified content and visual-form review.
sources.media_exclusion: Original local SVG illustrations only; no third-party media is used.
